event.title: US Implements New Tariffs on Over 80 Countries Amid Forced Labor Concerns
event.canonical_title: US Implements New Tariffs on Over 80 Countries Amid Forced Labor Concerns
event.summary: The United States has announced new tariffs ranging from 10% to 12.5% on 60 economies, citing inadequate enforcement of a ban on goods produced with forced labor. This decision comes as a continuation of trade measures aimed at addressing labor issues in international supply chains. Australia has expressed strong opposition to the tariffs, claiming they violate the existing free trade agreement with the US

timeline.title: US Implements New Tariffs on Over 80 Countries Amid Forced Labor Concerns
timeline.summary: The United States has imposed new tariffs on over 80 countries, citing concerns over forced labor. This action replaces a temporary global duty that was enacted after the US Supreme Court invalidated previous tariffs in February.
key_facts: New tariffs imposed on over 80 countries
